newsitem.title: UK: Northstar shows premium on AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: Northstar shows premium on AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in property investment company Northstar Securities Plc showed a premium on their first day of trading on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on Friday.
The ordinary shares, issued at 25p, were quoted at 28-1/2p by 1041 GMT but dealers said the trading activity was in the warrants.
Northstar's warrants gained 2p from their opening price to be quoted at 5p.
"All the interest is in the warrants this morning. It seems a cheap way into the company," said one dealer.

Northstar raised 1.5 million stg from the issue of six million ordinary shares in units comprising five ordinary shares and one warrant. The company had already raised 600,000 stg through a private placing. The proceeds from the float will be used to manage a portfolio of commercial and industrial properties bought from the 3M Pension Fund and to acquire other properties as opportunities arise, the company said. --Andrew Langlands, London Newsroom, +44 171 542 3496
